description: Change requests: a change asked of one page of your workspace's app — what, who asked, the customer, the Jira story and the issue, the priority, when it is due — made with Code Fix (the AI's proposal, approved = applied and saved in the working folder, tried, sent on) and followed until it is fixed (desktop/lib/changeRequests.js, /__fix/cr-*).

pages.description: The workspace app's pages (the Application pages catalog).

crId.description: The change request open in this tab (its id; 'new-…' for a new one). Empty: the list.

page.description: A new change request's page (app/flow/page), when opened from a page.

an.description: The analytics of every change request (resources/js/crAnalytics.js model), worked out when the list loads.

listStatus.description: The list's filter chip: all | open | progress | fixed | hold | closed.

cr.description: The change request open (a copy being edited).

fix.description: Its Code Fix shown (the latest attempt, or one picked).

fixInfo.description: Where Code Fix writes (the workspace's working folder) and the AI it uses (/__fix/info).

attempts.description: Its Code Fix attempts, newest first: [{ id, status, at, by }].

refine.description: What to change in the proposal (Ask again).

code.description: One file of its Code Fix in full: { fix, file, files, before, after, regions, beforeRegions, from } (/__fix/code).

codeView.description: after (the code with the change) | before (as it was) | diff (only the change)

codeAt.description: The change outlined in the code (its index).

menuInfo.description: A new page: the app's menu (groups, items), its flows and where a page like it is registered (/__fix/app-menu).

kbDoc.description: The FDD chosen for the knowledge base, with its sections.

kbAsk.description: Asked for a knowledge base before the AI makes a new page (shown once; Ask the AI now goes on without).

crChanged.description: A change request was saved or removed in another tab: the list reads them again (shellBus topic change-requests-changed).
